about: Baselines for PerformanceBaselineTests, each the median of five runs on the Mac named below, in the build configuration named below. A test fails when its number is more than twice its baseline (measured twice before it fails) and prints a warning at 1.5 times. Rewrite this file with make perf-baselines after a deliberate change, on a quiet Mac.
